sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And Another Counsel for Applicant :- Vinod Kumar Tiwari

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Varma,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.

The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed with the prayer to quash the charge sheet dated 02.11.2021 as well as cognizance and summoning order dated 16.12.2021, under Sections 498A, 504, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P.Act, Police Station Koirana, District Bhadohi in Criminal Case No. 11946 of 2021 (State Vs. Anand Kumar Ojha and another) and non bailable warrant dated 20.07.2022 passed by the Civil Judge (Jr. Div.)/FTC Exploitation of Women, Bhadohi Gyanpur, arising out of Case Crime No. 115 of 2021 pending before him.
After arguing the matter at some length, learned counsel for the applicant submits that he wants to withdraw this application with liberty to the applicant to file his bail application before the Court of competent jurisdiction.
